title: ReproResult
description: Schema for storing individual paper reproducibility results, including metrics, deviations, and experimental metadata.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier of the paper being reproduced.

reported_metrics.description: Metrics reported in the original paper.

reproduced_metrics.description: Metrics calculated from the reproduced run.

deviations.description: Absolute deviations between reported and reproduced metrics.

score_s.description: Reproducibility score S (0-1), where 1 is perfect reproducibility.

experimental_replicates.description: Number of independent experimental replicates reported in the source data. Added per reviewer feedback (Linus Pauling, Marie Curie) to quantify experimental rigor.

reaction_conditions.description: Specific reaction conditions under which yields were measured. Added per reviewer feedback.

catalyst_loading.description: Catalyst loading as a percentage or molar equivalent.

yield_std_dev.description: Standard deviation of yields across experimental replicates. Added per reviewer feedback to assess variability.

execution_environment.description: Details of the environment where reproduction was attempted.

max_metric_std_dev.description: Maximum standard deviation observed across sensitivity analysis seeds.

model_parameters_count.description: Number of parameters in the original model, if available.

substitution_reason.description: Reason for model substitution if the original model was too large.
